description: Enlist the signer's wallet as a soldier in a Coin Clash faction and return a war pass. Requires the wallet to hold the faction coin: the tool requests a challenge, signs it with the wallet's Solana key (from the `secret` arg, or SOLANA_SECRET_KEY env), and the backend verifies the signature then checks a live on-chain holding. Returns `{ eligible, wallet, faction, amount, usd, warPass, reason, challengeExpiresAt }`. If `eligible` is false the wallet does not currently hold the coin (`reason: "not_a_holder"`) and `warPass` is null — buy/hold the coin and retry. Keep the `warPass`: pass it to rally_faction to spend taps as battle power. No funds move; the pass expires after ~30 minutes.

secret.description: Base58 Solana secret of the enlisting wallet. Falls back to SOLANA_SECRET_KEY env. The wallet must hold the faction coin.

token.description: The faction coin mint to enlist for — must be a faction in get_clash_state.

name: enlist_faction
title: Enlist in a Coin Clash faction
